bandwidth_model: model_bytes = processed*(4 queue-read + 3 img-recolor + 4 depth-write [+ 2 owner-write if instrumented]) + processed*n_dirs*3 img-read (n_dirs = connectivity) + cas_attempts*8 (visited CAS RMW) + (filled-1)*4 (enqueue writes). Derived lower-bound model of algorithmic traffic: ~61 B/pixel on solid interiors at 4-conn, ~105 B/pixel at 8-conn (double the probes, roughly double the interior CAS attempts). L2 caching deflates real DRAM bytes, 32B sectors inflate them. Compare only against the measured copy peak; ncu is ground truth.
